name: Deliverect
oneLiner: Order management platform that connects delivery marketplaces, a restaurant's own online ordering, POS and kitchen systems, now with AI agents for menus and order monitoring.
bestFor: Multi-location restaurants, franchises and virtual brands juggling several delivery and online ordering channels that want orders and menus synced to the POS automatically.

updates.text: Papa Johns selected Deliverect's Smart Dispatch & Delivery Management platform, with rollout across its U.S. restaurants planned by the end of 2027.

Launched Deliverect AI, autonomous agents that reorder menus from live order data and watch digital orders for errors, plus smart assistants that update menu imagery and descriptions; UK first, other markets to follow.

features: Sends orders from delivery apps and web ordering straight into the POS, with no tablet re-keying
Central menu management that pushes menus, prices and item availability to every channel
Branded online ordering, including social media ordering
Dispatch and delivery management for in-house drivers and third-party couriers
Cross-channel, cross-location sales reporting in one dashboard
AI agents that optimize menus and flag ordering errors (rolling out by market)
Integrations with major POS systems, including the Toast partner ecosystem

pricing.text: Per-location monthly subscription, billed annually; the pricing page estimates a price from monthly order volume and number of locations, and groups of more than 50 locations get a quote.

notes: Deliverect site could not be fetched; details from search snippets and trade press.
